intro: The 100 hour Yoga Teacher Training is perfect for individuals who want to immerse themselves in the fundamentals of yoga but may not have the time to commit to a full-length course. It is designed specifically for beginners or those looking to improve their daily routine. In 13 days, you will be taught various yoga styles, such as traditional Hatha Yoga poses combined with dynamic flows of vinyasa techniques and the rigorous Ashtanga Vinyasa Yoga.

In this 100 Yoga Teacher Training in Rishikesh India, you will acquire knowledge beyond just yoga asanas. We will demonstrate meditation techniques (even if you believe you cannot stay still), instruct you on beneficial breathing techniques called Pranayama (your stress will be reduced), and explore the intriguing philosophy of yoga. Additionally, you will be taught yoga anatomy – however, rest assured, we ensure that it is enjoyable and useful in your daily life, self practice, and teaching in the future.

This training is the initial portion of our 200 hour yoga teacher training course. When you feel prepared, you are welcome to return and finish the second part in order to earn your complete certification from Yoga Alliance. There is no need to rush or feel pressured – prioritize what works best for you.

dining.text: At the Himalayan Yoga Association, we hold our food to the highest standards — not only in taste and nourishment but also in cleanliness, hygiene, and purity. Ingredients are washed with purified water, and our staff are trained to ensure a safe, hygienic, and sacred environment.

arrival: The course starts on 1st of every month at 3:30 pm with the opening ceremony & orientation program. In order for you to rest properly before the opening ceremony on the 1st day of the course, the check-in to the school should be one-day before the course begins. Your check in time must be between 10 AM to 4 PM. We provide you a complimentary stay for that night. Your check out on the last day of the course must be between 12 PM to 2 PM.

The best and most convenient way to travel to Rishikesh is to take a flight to Jolly Grant Airport (Dehradun – DED). Jolly Grant Airport is only about 25 kms from school. As soon as you book your flight, forward us your flight details and we will send our driver to receive you from the airport.
Complimentary pick-up service from the Jolly Grant Airport (Dehradun) is included in the course fee. Please provide your flight information once you book it, and we will arrange a pick-up for you.
